completeness_rule: Complete native API detail rendition for one publisher catalog period: finite current directory and catalog arrays, declared bill count, every available member-period vote and sponsorship array, and byte-identical directory/catalog/styles rereads. Current directory identities remain beside historical score sets; no complete historical roster, UI grade/lifetime conversion, or undisclosed metric participation is invented. All neutral/hidden actions, source placeholder dates, signed voteRating metadata and primarySponsor booleans remain literal. Any failed detail refuses the entire scope.
qualification_boundary: Named source rendition; remaining editions and renditions stay in scope
